Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

refresh-pdfbench · benchmark task: PDFBench distinguishes explicit field-name tasks supplying field names, locations and values from semantic tasks describing what fields mean in ordinary language.

candidate.next12.pdfbench.instruction-arms.v2

  • The two instruction arms and screenshot conditions are configurations within the same retained family. No model-performance ranking is proposed.

refresh-pdfbench · dataset size: Refresh’s PDFBench report describes 70 form-filling tasks across nine form types, a tile labeled 12 configurations by 90 tasks and 1,082 trials; its one-pager separately lists 200 PDFBench tasks.

candidate.next12.pdfbench.scope-conflicts.v2

  • These conflicting task/trial populations remain source-specific.12×90 equals 1080, so the 1,082 total is not silently repaired or treated as independently verified.
  • Counts, form types and configurations are not additional logical benchmark families.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

refresh-pdfbench · documents: PDFBench’s report distinguishes strict task passing from field-level correctness and illustrates a failed form despite 46 of 49 fields being filled correctly.

candidate.next12.pdfbench.scoring-distinction.v2

  • The example does not supply a complete executable scoring/adjudication protocol for every task. Underlying form permissions, label authorship and all business-rule dependencies remain unverified.
